scope: Immutable source inspection only; causes of HOLD remain unquantified
observations: Frozen transport sums all positive step energy deposits in each Scin bin, then applies energy broadening and window checks at event end.
Frozen detector-local scatter helper accounts for first-Compton recoil with escape and first-Compton followed by photoelectric absorption as windowed contributions.
Its second-Compton partition contributes to partition closure/probability diagnostics, but does not directly add a windowed contribution in that local helper.
The full Scatter kernel separately includes inter-crystal and collimator scatter terms; absence in the local helper is not a measured whole-response missing fraction.
C440to218 frozen switches enable local recoil and disable same-crystal full-energy photoelectric follow-up; the final C matrix is Scatter-only, as preregistered.
hypothesis: A candidate for further read-only investigation is whether represented scatter histories and finite quadrature sufficiently reproduce cumulative per-crystal 440-to-218 deposited energies. These data do not assign the 24.02% shortfall to a specific mechanism.
